classes.name: Stormshifter
classes.tagline: A high utility class that can both harm and heal with equal mastery!
classes.flavor:
The trees whisper their excitement, the clouds sing with glee. Rejoice! The Master of Storm & Fang arrives. Legend speaks of an ancient union between mortal and dryad—beings capable of wielding lightning and tempests as others wield blade and shield. This is but half the tale.

Wanderers recount encounters with beings, some wise and benevolent, others fearsome, with claws that sparked with lightning and pelts sharp as daggers. They are as one with storm and beast, embodying the serene beauty and raw power of nature’s grace.
highlights: Aid your allies in whatever role is most needed. Damage, healing, or control.
Wade into the fray as a shapeshifted beast ranging from friendly to vicious, indomitable, or HORRIBLE.
Cast powerful spells from a distance to strike down, control, mend, and more.

casting.notes: You know the Lightning & Wind schools, and can cast those cantrips. Mana recharges on a Safe Rest. Stormcaller: Learn a Utility Spell from each spell school you know.

sidebars.title: Stormshifter Names

options.name: Fearsome Beast
options.text:
Transform into a Large beast. Gain WIL Defense, WIL+LVL temp HP, advantage on STR saves, and:
Fearsome. Whenever you Interpose or Defend, you may spend 1 mana to force the attacker to reroll the attack (you must choose either result).
Gore. 1 Action: 1d8+LVL damage, on hit: gain LVL temp HP.

options.name: Beast of the Pack
options.text:
Transform into a Medium beast. Gain +DEX Speed, you can move DEX spaces for free each turn, advantage on DEX saves, and:
Lightning Step. (1/turn) Spend 1 mana to teleport DEX spaces for free.
Frenzy. 1 Action: 1d6+LVL damage. Your next attack gains increasing advantage instead of disadvantage. This bonus resets whenever you crit, or after you use a different attack.

options.name: Beast of Nightmares
options.text:
Transform into any Tiny beast or insect (provided it is horrible). Gain:
Silent But Deadly. Speed: 2. Attackers cannot target you until you become conspicuous (e.g., attacking or being seen transforming). Attacks against you have disadvantage. You cannot Defend or Interpose and any damage ends this form.
Sting. 1 Action: (1/round, Reach 0) 1d4+3×LVL acid damage (ignoring Armor), on crit: Dazed.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.text: Whenever you Defend vs a melee attack, you can Blind the attacker until the beginning of their next turn. Can move, breathe, and fight underwater without penalty.

options.name: Climber
options.text: Can walk across walls and ceilings normally; ignores Difficult Terrain.

options.name: Fleet Footed
options.text: Can move 2 spaces for free each turn. Advantage on Stealth checks and vs Grappled.

options.name: Earthwalker
options.text: +STR Defense. Can burrow through the ground (as long as you do not end your turn underground). Can stand from Prone for free on your turn.

options.name: Keen Senses
options.text: Advantage on Perception and Assess checks. Unaffected by Blind.

options.name: Leader of the Pack
options.text: Advantage against fear and charm effects for yourself and allies within Reach 6. Allies can move 2 spaces toward you for free on each of their turns.

options.name: Phasebeast
options.text: Whenever you shift between this form and your normal form (and vice versa), you may teleport up to 6 spaces away to a place you can see.

options.name: Prehensile Tail
options.text: Your melee attacks gain: On hit: Grappled (max 1).

options.name: Winged
options.text: Gain a flying Speed. Forced movement moves you twice as far while flying.

subclasses.name: Circle of Sky & Storm
subclasses.flavor: Attune to the skies above, vast and endless in their reach. Wield the oncoming storm, endless in its intensity.

features.name: Deepening Study
features.text: Choose the Ice or Radiant school to learn.

features.name: Creature of the Fey
features.text: You may cast spells while Beastshifted.

features.name: Attuned to Nature
features.text: (WIL/Safe Rest) Add LVL to any skill check related to nature or weather.

features.name: Raging Tempest
features.text: Whenever you crit with a spell, you may cast a cantrip for free from a school you haven’t cast any spells from this turn.

features.name: Primordial Force
features.text:
(1/round) Your tiered spells grant an additional effect:
• Ice. Gain WIL temp HP.
• Lightning. Deal additional WIL damage.
• Radiant. (Reach 6) Heal a creature WIL HP.
• Wind. Fly up to 6 spaces for free.

features.name: Master of Storm
features.text: You can concentrate on 1 lightning spell and 1 wind spell at the same time. (1/encounter) When you would cast a tiered spell, it costs 1 fewer action and 3 fewer mana.

subclasses.name: Circle of Fang & Claw
subclasses.flavor: Channel primal forces to transform faster and fiercer than before. Embody the ferocity of the wilds, and unleash it on nearby foes.

features.name: Swiftshift
features.text: Whenever you roll Initiative, you may Beastshift for free. (1/turn) You can Beastshift between Direbeast forms for 0 actions (this still costs a Direbeast form charge).

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Gore also Taunts until the end of the target’s next turn. Frenzy increases to 1d8+LVL damage.

features.name: Windborne Protector
features.text: Double the WIL Defense and temp HP bonuses from Fearsome Beast form. (1/encounter) You may Interpose from Reach 12.

features.name: Stormstrider
features.text: Double the DEX movement and Speed bonuses from Beast of the Pack. When you move as a Beast of the Pack, you may teleport instead.

features.name: Master of Forms
features.text: (1/encounter) When you would miss or crit while in a Direbeast form, you may increase or decrease the Primary Die by 1 instead.

features.name: Chimeric Sovereign
features.text: You know all Chimeric Boons, your Direbeast forms can have 2 at a time.

subclasses.name: Circle of Cinder & Ash
subclasses.flavor: Fire has an important duty in nature, responsible for clearing portions of forests of impurities or old invasive species to clear it out for the new.

features.name: Wildfire
features.text: Replace your lightning or wind spell school with the fire school.

features.name: Searing Fang
features.text: Before you Beastshift you may cast Enchant Weapon on yourself for free.

features.name: Firesight
features.text: You have advantage on skill checks related to fire.

features.name: Phoenix Flame
features.text: (1/encounter) You may cast Pyroclasm for 0 mana; gain temp HP equal to the amount rolled. Dying does not cause your Beastshift forms to end; while Dying you gain flying.

features.name: Cinderhide
features.text: You can cast Flame Barrier while Beastshifted and do so for 2 fewer mana.

features.name: Kindled Kin
features.text: Whenever you gain temp HP, choose an ally within Reach 6 to gain the same amount.

sidebars.title: Free Spells
sidebars.text: They are cast at their base tier but you may spend additional mana as normal to upcast them.

subclasses.name: Circle of Venom & Web
subclasses.flavor: Stormshifters who align themselves with the nature of spiders and utilize their power from these tiny but deadly creatures.

features.name: Deadly Nature
features.text: Replace your lightning or wind school with necrotic.

features.name: Too Many Legs, Too Many Eyes
features.text: Your Beastforms gain Climber or Keen Senses for free.

features.name: Venom Sacs
features.text: Your Beastform attacks gain: On hit: you may spend mana to increase your Primary Die by 1 for each mana spent (up to the tier of spells you have unlocked); On crit: Poisoned until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Ensnare
features.text: Whenever you Interpose or Defend vs a melee attack, you may spend 1 mana to Restrain the attacker until the end of their next turn if it is your size or smaller.

features.name: Sudden Terror
features.text: (1/encounter) Reaction (when attacked in melee): shift into a Beast of Nightmares for free, gain Riding (they must reroll with disadvantage).

features.name: Dread Voice
features.text: You may cast necrotic spells while Beastshifted.

features.name: Fear Toxin
features.text: Your Poison also Frightens.

features.name: Skitter
features.text: Your Beast of Nightmares form gets the Fleet Footed Chimeric Boon for free.

features.name: Spiderling Swarm
features.text: Ensnare also Poisons creatures for as long as they are Restrained.

spells.name: Zap
spells.text: Range: 8. Damage: 1d8+4. On miss: you take half the damage instead.

spells.name: Overload
spells.text:
Castable only if Charged, ending the condition. Reach: 2, AoE. Damage: 2d8.

Charged. Whenever you take lightning damage, you are Charged for 1 minute (or until combat ends).

spells.name: Arc Lightning
spells.text:
Range: 12. Damage: 3d8. Also hits the next closest creature.

Next Closest Creature. If you are the closest, you are hit! If 2 creatures are equally close, the GM can select randomly, the taller one, or whoever has the most metal.

spells.name: Alacrity
spells.text: (1/turn) Teleport up to your Speed, gain Charged (can be cast while Defending, after damage).

spells.name: Stormlash
spells.text: Line: 12, AoE. Damage: 3d8+4 and Prone on a failed STR save. Creatures with a large amount of metal (e.g., armor or a longsword) roll with disadvantage and suffer +10 damage.

spells.name: Electrickery
spells.text: Castable when an ally is attacked. Range: 8. Teleport an ally away. Teleport another creature there on a failed WIL save (making them the target). Costs 1 action if Charged, ending the condition.

spells.name: Electrocharge
spells.text: Reach: 4. Concentration: Up to 1 min. Give a creature Charged, +1 max action, +5 Defense, 2× Speed, and advantage on DEX saves.

spells.name: Ride the Lightning
spells.text: Reach: 12, AoE. Teleport to a spot you can see (if a willing creature is there, swap places with them). Adjacent creatures take d88 damage and Knockback 2. Creatures moved 2+ spaces are also knocked Prone, Dazed, and deafened for 1 day.

spells.name: Seething Storm
spells.text:
Concentration: 1 min. Become a cloud of tempestuous storm. You can fly, move for free 1/round, and attacks against you are disadvantaged. At the end of each of your turns, strike up to 4 creatures within Reach 4 with a bolt of lightning for d88 damage (a creature can only be struck 1/round). Costs 3 actions each round to maintain. +2 Reach and +2 lightning bolts each round.

Note. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before you can use it again.

spells.name: Razor Wind
spells.text: Range: 12. Range: 12. Damage: 2d4 slashing, with advantage OR include a 2nd creature adjacent to your target.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.text: Range: 6. Restore 1d4 HP to a Dying creature. If healed for 4+: they also regain 1 action.

spells.name: Blustery Gale
spells.text: Range: 12. Damage: 3d4 bludgeoning, Knockback 2 (advantage vs flying/Small/Tiny). Forced movement deals +5 damage instead of rolling additional dice.

spells.name: Barrier of Wind
spells.text: Castable only while Defending vs Ranged. Reach: 1. Reduce the Primary Die by 3. If it misses, redirect the original attack to another space in Reach.

spells.name: Echoburst
spells.text: Reach: 1. Damage: d44 bludgeoning (ignoring armor). Any creature in the targeted space at the beginning of your next turn takes this damage again.

spells.name: Eye of the Storm
spells.text: Reach: 3, AoE. Damage: 4d4+10 bludgeoning to enemies. Place surviving creatures anywhere within 1 space of the storm’s Reach on a failed STR save.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.text: Reach: 12, 5×5 AoE. Damage: 20 bludgeoning minus a DEX save. On 10+ damage, they land Prone and Dazed.

spells.name: Thousand Cuts
spells.text:
Range: 12. Damage: d44 slashing with advantage. Also damages enemies within Reach 1 of your target.

D44 with advantage. Roll 3d4 and drop the lowest die. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 2, 3, and 4 deals 34 damage).

spells.name: Boisterous Winds
spells.text: Reach: 12. Gently move all creatures up to 6 spaces, each in a straight line in a direction of your choice. At the beginning of your subsequent turns, do so again but 2 fewer spaces.

faq.q: Does shifting into a harmless beast have a time limit or take a charge?
Can I cast spells while shifted?
faq.a: Yes. But it ends the form (unless you have a special ability that allows you to maintain it).

faq.q: When shifting between one Direbeast Form and another, do I keep the temp HP and Frenzy bonuses?
faq.a: Yes, though they end when combat does if unspent. The other passive effects (e.g., extra Defense or movement) are not maintained.

faq.q: Can I build up advantage with Frenzy then cast a spell with it?
Does the temp HP from Fearsome Beast and Gore stack?
faq.a: No. Temp HP do not stack.
Yes. Although dropping to 0 HP ends any currently active forms, you can shift again while Dying.

classes.name: The Cheat
classes.tagline: High burst damage class that can get in and get out!
classes.flavor:
The Cheat doesn’t call herself a Cheat, of course—rather, a streetsmart rogue, a survivalist, or a liberator of unused goods. They are masters of stealth, pickpocketing, and smooth talking. Some of the more vicious ilk are masters of death-dealing as well.

Cheats can be found in every city and byway under countless different names, but they all believe something similar: It’s a cruel, merciless world, and those who aim to survive don’t have time for silly things like “morals” or “honor.” Those are luxuries of the rich and powerful. Honor gets you killed—survival is about taking what you want, when you can.
highlights: Break the rules! You can change the dice you roll to whatever numbers suit you best!
Sneakily backstab enemies with devastating crits. Take down even heavily armored foes with a single blow!
Fight dirty with pocket sand and low blows. When things turn ugly, disappear and live to cheat another day!

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text: (1/turn) When you crit, deal +1d6 damage.

features.name: Vicious Opportunist
features.text: (1/turn) When you HIT a Distracted target with a melee attack, you may change the Primary Die roll to whatever you like (changing it to the max value counts as a crit).

features.name: Cheat
features.text:
You’re a well-rounded cheater. Gain the following abilities:
• (1/round) You may either Move or Hide for free.
• (1/Safe Rest) You may change any of your skill checks to 10+INT.
• If you roll less than 10 on Initiative, you may change it to 10 instead.
• You may gain advantage on skill checks while playing any games, competitions, or placing wagers. If you’re caught though…

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Choose an Epic Boon (see pg. 75 of the GM’s Guide).

features.name: Supreme Execution
features.text: +1 to any 2 of your stats. When you attack with a blade, you do not require targets to be Distracted to trigger Vicious Opportunist.

sidebars.title: Distracted
sidebars.text: A target is Distracted if it is adjacent to (or Taunted by) an ally, or if it cannot see you. Yes! If you can figure out how to attack on someone else’s turn, you can use this again in the same round!

sidebars.title: Magic?
sidebars.text: The Cheat has some abilities that look magical—they might be, but don’t have to be. You have your ways, okay? No need to explain how you did that, not even to the GM!

sidebars.title: Trade Secrets
sidebars.text: Whenever you spend a night talking shop with other roguish types during a Safe Rest, you may choose different Cheat options available to you.

options.name: “Creative” Accounting
options.text: Steal up to INT actions from your next turn (Gain up to INT actions now. The next time you would gain actions, subtract the number stolen). You cannot use this 2 turns in a row.

options.name: Exploit Weakness
options.text: Whenever you successfully Assess: Create an Opening against a creature, you can use Vicious Opportunist against them, even if they are not Distracted. This lasts for 1 minute or until you use it against another target.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.text: If you miss for the 2nd time in a single round, you may change the Primary Die roll to any result instead.

options.name: How’d YOU get here?!
options.text: (Reach 12) “Teleport” adjacent to a Distracted target, and make a melee attack against them. If you crit, you may “teleport” again.

options.name: I’m Outta Here!
options.text: When an ally within Reach 4 is crit, you may turn Invisible until the end of your next turn and then move up to half your Speed for free.

options.name: Misdirection
options.text: Gain INT Defense. Whenever you Defend, you may halve the damage instead.

options.name: Steal Tempo
options.text: When you crit for the second time in a round, your target is Dazed and you give an ally 1 action.

options.name: Sunder Armor
options.text: After you crit an armored creature, sunder their armor: give the next non-crit Primary Die rolled against them +2.

options.name: Tangling Wire
options.text: Whenever you Grapple, you may Restrain instead.

options.name: The Setup
options.text: Reaction (when an ally misses a creature adjacent to you): You can make an Opportunity Attack against them, treating them as Distracted.

options.name: Trickshot
options.text: You can use Vicious Opportunist on thrown weapon attacks (but you can’t use Twist the Blade on them). Whenever you throw a weapon, you may spend an additional action to have it hit another creature within Reach 2 of it, dealing half as much damage to them.

features.name: Amidst All This Commotion…
features.text: If a creature dies while you Sneak Attack them, you may turn Invisible until you attack again or until the beginning of your next turn.

features.name: Leave No Trace
features.text: Advantage on Stealth checks when you are at full health.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.text: Deal +2×INT damage whenever you crit.

features.name: Professional Skulker
features.text: Gain a climbing Speed and advantage on Stealth checks (replaces Leave No Trace).

features.name: KILL
features.text: When you Sneak Attack an enemy with fewer max HP than you, it dies.

features.name: Low Blow
features.text:
When you Sneak Attack a creature not already Taunted by you, you may spend 1 additional action to roll 1d4. They are:
1. Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
2. Knocked Prone, then Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
3. Dazed, then Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
4. Incapacitated until the end of the next hero’s turn.

features.name: Sweet Talk
features.text: You may gain advantage on all Influence checks with NPCs you’ve just met for the first time. This lasts until you fail an Influence check with them or until you meet a 2nd time. You have disadvantage on Influence checks with them after you use this ability (until you get back on their good side).

features.name: Pocket Sand
features.text: (2/encounter—you’ve got to collect more sand!) When you Defend against an adjacent creature, Blind the attacker until the start of their next turn and force them to reroll the attack (Blind creatures attack with disadvantage).

features.name: Escape Plan
features.text: (1/Safe Rest) When you would drop to 0 HP or gain a Wound, you don’t. Instead, you turn Invisible for 1 minute or until you attack.

features.name: Heads I Win, Tails You Lose
features.text: (1/encounter) Attacks you make this round don’t miss, you crit on 1 less than normally needed, and you gain LVL temp HP.

subclasses.name: Tools of the Serpent
subclasses.flavor: You have harnessed the terrible fangs of nature to her deadly array of poisons. Choose this subclass if you want to debilitate your foes with venom and viciousness.

features.name: Viper’s Kiss
features.text: Creatures you damage become Poisoned until the end of their next turn. Creatures Poisoned this way are also Distracted.

features.name: I’ve Tried This One Before
features.text: You have advantage on saves against poison. Additionally, you can identify any poison you inspect.

features.name: Noxious Cloud
features.text: (1/encounter, Reach 4) Action: Enemies in a 2×2 area take INT d6 damage (ignoring armor) and become Poisoned. Creatures already Poisoned are also Dazed.

features.name: Cruel Dose
features.text: Creatures Poisoned by you are also Slowed and their attack Range is halved.

features.name: Volatile Toxins
features.text: Noxious Cloud can be used twice each encounter. Whenever a creature Poisoned by you dies, their body erupts into a Noxious Cloud.

subclasses.name: Tools of the Gambler
subclasses.flavor: Trust me—this time it’s a SURE THING. Choose this subclass if you want to risk it all with dangerous plays and walk the line of ruin.

features.name: All In
features.text: When you Sneak Attack, you may go All In: Roll a single All In die; if it rolls higher than average, maximize ALL of your Sneak Attack dice; otherwise minimize them.

features.name: That Was Just a Practice Roll
features.text: (1/encounter) You may reroll ANY die.

features.name: It’s All Fun and Games
features.text: If you’re caught cheating at a game, competition, or wager, you gain advantage on skill checks to get out of the consequences.

features.name: Pocket Aces!
features.text: (1/Safe Rest) You can set a friendly creature’s Initiative roll to 20.

features.name: Double or Nothing!
features.text: When you lose your “All In” roll, you may try once more. If you succeed, add 1 additional maximized Sneak Attack die. If you fail, your attack misses entirely and your turn ends.

features.name: Play the Odds
features.text: (1/round) When a creature hits you, you may force them to reroll their Primary Die. If the roll is lower, the attack misses; otherwise, it crits.

features.name: Odds Maker
features.text: You may use That Was Just a Practice Roll 2/encounter and you may instead change the die to any other face.

subclasses.name: The Honorseeker
subclasses.intro:
Honorseeker. You give up Sneak Attack, Vicious Opportunist, Underhanded Abilities, and Twist the Blade, in exchange gain:
• Honorable Gambits. For every Underhanded Ability you would have (except for your Old Habits…), choose an Honorable Gambit instead.
• Worthy Underdog. When enemies have The Upper Hand, attacks miss you on 2 or less.
• Tenacious Fighter. (1/turn) When you HIT an enemy that has The Upper Hand you may change the Primary Die roll to whatever you like and deal +1d6 damage (this increases as your Sneak Attack dice would).

sidebars.title: The Upper Hand
sidebars.text: Whenever there are more of them adjacent to you than allies.

features.name: Prove Your Worth!
features.text: (Reach 12, 1/turn) Taunt an enemy for free (lasts until they damage you). Gain DEX damage reduction vs enemies Taunted by you.

features.name: Even the Odds
features.text: When attacking or being attacked by an enemy with The Upper Hand, you may spend an action to change a die up or down 1 face (replaces Twist the Blade and improves as it would).

features.name: Old Habits…
features.text: Choose 1 Underhanded Ability.

features.name: Right Where I Want You
features.text: You have advantage on attacks and +10 Defense as long as enemies have The Upper Hand.

features.name: Turn the Tables
features.text: When an enemy with The Upper Hand misses you in melee, you may spend an action attacking them in return.

features.name: Supreme Underdog
features.text: (Replaces Supreme Execution…) You take 10 less damage from all attacks by creatures with The Upper Hand.

optionGroups.name: Honorable Gambits
optionGroups.intro: For every Underhanded Ability you would have (except for your Old Habits…), choose an Honorable Gambit instead:

options.name: Deft Parry
options.text: You take –INT damage from enemies while they have The Upper Hand.

options.name: Down, Not Out!
options.text: While Dying, reduce all Primary Dice rolled against you by 1, and you gain advantage on saves.

options.name: Frightful Confidence
options.text: While Bloodied, when you are attacked with advantage their lowest die is Primary.

options.name: Mark of Deflection
options.text: If you’ve already Defended this round, attacks against you are rolled with disadvantage.

options.name: Nowhere to Flee!
options.text: Gain +INT Speed when moving toward enemies Taunted by you. Your Opportunity Attacks also Slow Medium or smaller targets on hit.

options.name: Redemption Arc
options.text: Reaction (when an enemy with The Upper Hand attacks an ally): You may first Taunt them (the attack is rolled again, choose either result), this lasts until the end of their next turn.

options.name: Riposte
options.text: When you Defend against a melee attacker, you may immediately make an Opportunity Attack against them.

options.name: Say That to My Face!
options.text: Action: (Reach 12) “Teleport” adjacent to a Taunted enemy.

options.name: Victor’s Confidence
options.text: When you kill a Taunted enemy, give an ally advantage on their next attack.

classes.name: Zephyr
classes.tagline: A furiously fast melee class that can deliver and avoid terrible blows.
classes.flavor:
A Zephyr dedicates their life to the relentless pursuit of kinetic prowess. They hone their bodies into blurs of motion, training from a young age in remote wilds or mountain monasteries, wielding speed to unleash blows that echo through their foes and slip past attacks like a whispering wind. Speed is both their weapon and shield.

Through ceaseless training, they harness their inner momentum to achieve feats of supernatural agility, executing every motion with flowing precision.
highlights: You’re a relentless force on the battlefield. Absorb blows and deliver devastating strikes.
Move with unparalleled speed and determination, outpacing your allies and foes alike.
Retaliate with precision and turn enemy strikes into opportunities for devastating counterattacks.

resources.name: Momentum
resources.reset: lost if you take damage, or at the end of combat

features.name: Iron Defense
features.text: Your Defense is DEX+STR as long as you are unarmored.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: Gain 1 Momentum for every space you move. You may expend 1 Momentum to add 1 damage to any melee attack. All Momentum is lost if you take damage, or at the end of combat.

features.name: Burst of Speed
features.text:
When you roll Initiative, gain DEX Bursts of Speed for this encounter. You may spend 1 Burst of Speed to use one of the following maneuvers:
• Slipstream. Whenever you Defend: Apply your Defense to every attack against you this round OR you may first move 1 space.
• Galeforce Strike. Roll 1d12 for an unarmed attack instead of 1d4.
• Windstep. Move for free, ignoring enemy spaces this turn.

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Choose a Zephyr subclass.

features.name: Piercing Blows
features.text: You may spend Momentum before you make an Unarmed Strike to gain advantage for every 2 spent.

features.name: Reactive Force
features.text: Whenever you gain a Wound, gain a Burst of Speed.

features.name: Martial Master
features.text: Choose a Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Supernatural Speed
features.text: While unarmored, you may use Momentum to treat a Primary Die rolled against you as if it rolled 1 lower for every 2 Momentum spent.

features.name: Iron Defense (2)
features.text: Your Defense is (3×STR)+DEX as long as you are unarmored.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Martial Master (2)
features.text: Choose a 2nd Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Swift Fists
features.text: If you have no actions and haven’t attacked this turn, your Galeforce Strike costs 0 actions.

features.name: Infuse Strength
features.text: Whenever you make an Unarmed Strike, you may expend 1 or more Hit Dice and add them to the strike’s total. Instead of dealing damage, heal the target for that amount (you can use Momentum or other abilities as normal).

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Gain your Zephyr subclass feature.

features.name: Galeforce Strike (2)
features.text: Your Galeforce Strike increases to 1d20.

features.name: Martial Master (3)
features.text: Choose a 3rd Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Swift Feet
features.text: Gain +2 to your Speed and Initiative as long as you are unarmored.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Martial Master (4)
features.text: Choose a 4th Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Unyielding Resolve
features.text: Ignore the first Wound you would suffer each encounter (when-Wounded abilities, such as Reactive Force, still trigger).

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Gain your Zephyr subclass feature.

features.name: Kinetic Marvel
features.text: Double the damage granted by Momentum.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Unyielding Resolve (2)
features.text: Ignore the first 2 Wounds you would suffer each encounter.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Blur
features.text: Gain 10 Momentum when you roll Initiative.

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Gain your Zephyr subclass feature.

features.name: Swift Feet (2)
features.text: Gain another +2 to your Speed and Initiative as long as you are unarmored.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Unyielding Resolve (3)
features.text: Ignore the first 3 Wounds you would suffer each encounter. You have advantage on STR saves while Dying.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Martial Master (5)
features.text: Choose a 5th Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Choose an Epic Boon (see pg. 75 of the GM’s Guide).

features.name: Windborne
features.text: +1 to any 2 of your stats. +1 additional Burst of Speed when you roll Initiative. Permanently gain 1 action (while Dying, you have a max of 2 actions).

sidebars.title: Focus
sidebars.text: Whenever you spend time meditating alone in a windy place during a Safe Rest, you may choose different Zephyr options available to you.

sidebars.title: Zephyr Names
sidebars.text:
Male Names: Araset, Nicanor, Leif, Sorrel, Bastian, Haze, Dash.
Female Names: Whisper, Aria, Syntyche, Trill, Sway, Glenda, Bliss.

options.name: Airshift
options.text: If you move through the space of a willing creature while using Windstep, they can move with you and choose any space adjacent to or along your path of movement to end in.

options.name: Bodily Discipline
options.text: End any single condition on yourself (ending Dying grants 1 HP, ending Dazed grants 1 action, etc.).

options.name: Cyclonic Pull
options.text: Whenever you avoid all of the damage of a melee attack (whether it misses or you Defend), you may swap places with the attacker.

options.name: Enduring Soul
options.text: Whenever you roll Initiative, gain Hit Dice equal to the actions you get on your first turn (they expire at the end of combat if unused).

options.name: I Jump on His Back!
options.text: You can Ride creatures your size. While Riding, gain advantage vs your Ride, ANY damage you avoid is dealt to them. If you move into the space of a creature your size or larger with Windstep or Skystrider, gain Riding for free.

options.name: Kinetic Barrage
options.text: (1/turn) Whenever you make a melee attack and spend no Momentum, gain DEX Momentum.

options.name: Mighty Soul
options.text: You cannot be moved against your will. Whenever you would fail a roll, you may gain a Wound in order to add STR to the result you rolled. Repeat this any number of times.

options.name: Quickstrike
options.text: Whenever you Interpose, you may first make an Unarmed Strike against the enemy for free.

options.name: Twisting Deflection
options.text: Reaction (when you avoid all of the damage of a melee attack—whether it misses or you Defend): Force another logical target within Reach to be hit instead.

options.name: Skystrider
options.text: You cannot be Grappled or Restrained while conscious. While moving, you may travel across ANY terrain ignoring all ill effects (e.g., Prone, enemies, ceilings, treetops, lava, spikes, clouds).

subclasses.name: Way of Pain
subclasses.flavor: Welcome the strikes of your enemies, and let them shape you. Your capacity for suffering is bottomless.

features.name: Bring the Pain
features.text: Damage no longer causes you to lose Momentum. (1/round) You may take 1 Wound to gain 10 Momentum for free.

features.name: Share My Pain
features.text: (1/round) Whenever you take damage, you can take half as much, and deal that much to another creature within Reach.

features.name: Pain Sharpens the Mind
features.text: While you are Bloodied, gain advantage.

features.name: Echoed Agony
features.text: Your Share My Pain can also target a 2nd creature within Reach 4.

subclasses.name: Way of Iron
subclasses.flavor: Train your body to be hard as iron. Concentrate to strengthen your defenses, then release the energy for devastating blows.

features.name: Steel Yourself
features.text: When you roll Initiative gain Tempered: (1/round) reduce an attack’s damage by 10 for free. When you hit, you may end Tempered to add 1d20 damage.

features.name: Iron Fists
features.text: When you end Tempered, roll its d20 with advantage.

features.name: Iron Body
features.text: You can double the Tempered damage reduction each round or use it 2/round. Gain Tempered the first time you would gain a Wound each encounter.

features.name: Infuse with Iron
features.text: When you use Infuse Strength, your target gains Tempered.

features.name: Perfect Alloy
features.text: Gain Tempered whenever you use a Burst of Speed.

subclasses.name: Way of Hurricanes
subclasses.flavor: Your fist is as the howling wind, unceasing and everflowing. Those who face you are battered and bruised by a whirlwind of deadly strikes.

features.name: Cyclone
features.text: (Reach 4) You may spend 1 Momentum to move a creature 1 space.

features.name: Cleaving Gale
features.text: Whenever you crit, you may deal that much damage to a 2nd creature within Reach 1 of your target. (1/turn) When you HIT, you may gain a Wound to change it into a crit.

features.name: Hurricane Strike
features.text: Your Galeforce Strike may gain: AoE, Reach 1.

features.name: Sidestep
features.text: After you are attacked, you may move 2 spaces (after damage resolves).

features.name: Forceful Gust
features.text: Your Unarmed Strikes can Knockback STR spaces; you may suffer 1 Wound to double the distance.

features.name: Tempest’s Fury
features.text: Whenever you would roll any extra dice for a crit, instead roll 1d20.

subclasses.name: Way of Flame
subclasses.flavor: Burn fiercely with the heat of battle, fight fast and reckless, and counter enemies with burning strikes.

features.name: Exploding Soul
features.text: Whenever you gain one or more Wounds, make an Unarmed Strike, dealing the damage to ALL others within Reach 1. (1/round) On your turn, you may suffer a Wound.

features.name: Burning Palm
features.text: Your Unarmed Strikes gain: On crit: Smoldering. You may double the effects of Momentum vs Smoldering creatures (ending the condition).

features.name: Chain Reaction
features.text: (1/turn) When you crit with an Unarmed Strike, deal fire damage equal to your STR+Momentum spent to creatures of your choice adjacent to your target. Repeat any number of times, targeting creatures not yet damaged by this effect this turn.

features.name: Encompassing Flames
features.text: You may double the Reach of Chain Reaction and Exploding Soul.

faq.q: Does movement while Riding or forced movement count toward my Momentum?
What does Slipstream’s move 1 space do?
faq.a: If the movement takes you beyond the Reach/Range of the attack or gives you Full Cover, the attack misses. If it gives you Cover, disadvantage applies as normal, the Primary Die is rolled again and the lower one taken.

faq.q: Can I Infuse Strength as an Opportunity Attack or Coordinated Strike?
Can I Defend or otherwise reduce the damage from Share My Pain?
faq.a: Yes, but that will likewise reduce the damage you deal in return.

faq.q: Could I take additional Wounds from Exploding Soul triggering while Dying?
faq.a: Yes, if you fail the STR save on attacks while Dying.
